steps.title: Screw in 2 cam bolts
steps.detail: Screw two cam bolts 118331 into the holes in the ends of the long piece, using a screwdriver. The picture at the top of the page shows the drawer that steps 1 to 8 build.

steps.title: Fit 2 dowels, join the sides
steps.detail: Press two wooden dowels 101344 into the holes shown, then join the two upright side pieces to the long piece.

steps.title: Fit 2 cam locks
steps.detail: Press a cam lock 103114 into each side piece and turn it with a screwdriver as shown. The picture crosses out cam locks 110126 and 103430 for this step.
warnings: Cam locks 110126 and 103430 are crossed out in this step: use only 103114.

steps.title: Raise sides, slide in base
steps.detail: Swing the side pieces up as the curved arrow shows, then slide the thin base panel in as the straight arrow shows. The close-up shows the panel's rough surface; match it to the manual's picture.

steps.title: Fit the front panel
steps.detail: Swing the front panel up onto the frame as the arrow shows. The close-up shows the panel's edge seated in the groove.

steps.title: Hammer in 2 bolts
steps.detail: Tap two bolts 110519 into the holes shown with a hammer. The small picture at the corner shows where the hammer is used.

steps.title: Place the drawer runners
steps.detail: Lower the two drawer runners onto the sides of the drawer as the arrows show. The runners are the parts on manual page 4 (112482, 2x). No fasteners in this step.

steps.title: Screw on the runners
steps.detail: Fix each runner with screws 100365 (4x in total). The picture crosses out screw 113287.
warnings: Screw 113287 is crossed out in this step: use only 100365.

steps.title: Fit 2 dowels
steps.detail: Press two dowels 101344 into the narrow panel's edge as shown on the carpet. From this step the pages follow the side you chose for the cabinet.

steps.title: Fit 2 dowels in the rail
steps.detail: Press two dowels 101344 into the ends of the rail. The two small pictures show which way the holes must face; the crossed-out one is the orientation to avoid.
warnings: Check the two small pictures: the crossed-out hole orientation must not be used.

steps.title: Screw in 8 cam bolts
steps.detail: Screw eight cam bolts 118331 into the edges of the two panels as shown, using a screwdriver.

steps.title: Screw runners onto panels
steps.detail: Fix one runner to each of the two panels with screws 100365. The picture crosses out screw 113287. The manual prints 1x for each runner and no screw count.

parts.name: small screw
parts.note: quantity not printed in the manual

warnings: Screw 113287 is crossed out in this step: use only 100365.

steps.title: Fit dowels, raise the sides
steps.detail: Press two dowels 101344 into the rail ends, then raise the side panels as the arrows show.

steps.title: Fit 8 cam locks
steps.detail: Press eight cam locks 103430 into the holes shown and turn each a quarter turn with a screwdriver. The picture crosses out cam lock 110126.
warnings: Cam lock 110126 is crossed out in this step: use only 103430.

steps.title: Screw runner onto panel
steps.detail: Fix the runner to the panel with screws 100365, as in step 12. The picture crosses out screw 113287.

parts.name: small screw
parts.note: quantity not printed in the manual

warnings: Screw 113287 is crossed out in this step: use only 100365.

steps.title: Fit 2 hinge plates
steps.detail: Fix two hinge plates 109221 with screws 113287; the plate's A mark is shown in the close-up. The picture crosses out screw 100365 for this step.

parts.name: wide-head screw
parts.note: quantity not printed in the manual

warnings: Screw 100365 is crossed out in this step: use 113287.

steps.title: Screw in 4 cam bolts
steps.detail: Screw four cam bolts 118331 into the panel edges shown, using a screwdriver.

steps.title: Slide in the back panel
steps.detail: Slide the thin back panel in as the arrow shows. The picture crosses out the rough, textured side: check which side the manual shows.
warnings: The rough, textured side is crossed out in the picture.

steps.title: Fit 2 cam locks
steps.detail: Press two cam locks 110126 into the holes shown and turn each with a screwdriver.

steps.title: Fit 4 dowels
steps.detail: Press four dowels 101344 into the edges of the small panel as shown. The close-up shows the panel's edge.

steps.title: Raise the side panel
steps.detail: Swing the side panel up as the arrow shows so its dowels enter their holes.

steps.title: Fit 2 cam locks
steps.detail: Press two cam locks 110126 into the holes shown and turn each with a screwdriver.

steps.title: Fit 6 dowels
steps.detail: Press six dowels 101344 into the holes shown along the panel edges.

steps.title: Bolt on the leg frame
steps.detail: Attach the metal leg frame with three long bolts 100086, turned with hex key 100092. The small picture at the top shows how the hex key 100092 fits into strip 121030.

parts.name: hex key
parts.note: tool shown; quantity not printed for this step

parts.name: tool strip
parts.note: tool shown; quantity not printed for this step

steps.title: Screw in 6 cam bolts
steps.detail: Screw six cam bolts 118331 into the large panel lying on the carpet, using a screwdriver.

steps.title: Join the frame and the panel
steps.detail: Move the assembled frame and the large panel together as the arrow shows, lining the cam bolts up with their holes.

steps.title: Fit 6 cam locks
steps.detail: Press six cam locks 110126 into the holes shown and turn each with a screwdriver.

steps.title: Fit 4 plastic fittings
steps.detail: Push four plastic fittings 153549 into the holes shown, as the close-up pictures.

steps.title: Press in 2 hexagon covers
steps.detail: Press the hexagon covers 10081375 into the holes of the leg frame, by hand. The picture crosses out the round covers 112519 and 121338 for this step.
warnings: The round covers 112519 and 121338 are crossed out in this step.

steps.title: Hang the drawer
steps.detail: Tilt the drawer up and let its runners catch the rails as the arrow and the top close-up show, then slide it in.

steps.title: Fit 2 hinges on the door
steps.detail: Lay the door flat and fix two hinges 109338 with screws 100365, as the close-up shows.

parts.name: small screw
parts.note: quantity not printed in the manual

instruction.line2: LAY IT FLAT AND SCREW ON

steps.title: Hang the door
steps.detail: Clip each hinge onto its plate as the arrow shows, then tighten the hinge screw with a screwdriver. Manual page 40 shows how to adjust the door; it is the third picture for this step.

parts.name: hinge
parts.note: already fixed to the door in step 31

steps.title: Fit 8 shelf pins and shelves
steps.detail: Push eight shelf pins 101514 into the holes and rest the two shelves on them, as the arrows show.

steps.title: Stick on 2 bumpers
steps.detail: Stick two adhesive bumpers 104663 where the close-up shows.

steps.title: Fit the grommet and covers
steps.detail: Press the cable grommet into the hole in the top and the four round covers over the holes shown. The manual prints alternate numbers for these parts: grommet 121208, 121186 or 10060533; covers 121338 or 130521.
